{{Quote|I met a Kel Dor a while back who told me he owned an orchard outside of Dor'shan.|Strono Tuggs, ''The Ultimate Cookbook''|<ref name="UltimateCookbook" />}}
'''Dor'shan''' was a location on the [[planet]] [[Dorin]], an [[Expansion Region]] world with a [[helium]]-rich [[atmosphere]] that was the [[homeworld]] of the [[Kel Dor]] [[species]]. A [[Unidentified Kel Dor orchard owner|Kel Dor]] owned an [[Unidentified orchard (Dorin)|orchard]] just outside Dor'shan which was visited by the [[Artiodac]] [[chef]] [[Strono Tuggs]] during a culinary tour of [[the galaxy]] that he took<ref name="UltimateCookbook" /> between [[34 ABY]] and [[35 ABY]].<ref name="UltimateDate">{{UltimateCookbookDate}}</ref> Tuggs later mentioned Dor'shan in his third [[Book|cookbook]], ''[[The Ultimate Cookbook]]'', which was published<ref name="UltimateCookbook" /> in 35 [['ABY-BBY' dating system|ABY]].<ref name="UltimateDate" />

==Behind the scenes==
In the current ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[canon]], Dor'shan was mentioned in the [[2023]] ''[[Star Wars: The Ultimate Cookbook]]'', a recipe book written by [[Jenn Fujikawa]] and [[Marc Sumerak]].<ref name="UltimateCookbook" /> The [[Dor'shan/Legends|location]] originated in the [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] continuity, where it was first mentioned in ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game Saga Edition Core Rulebook]]'', a [[2007]] rulebook for the ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game]]'' published by [[Wizards of the Coast]].<ref name="Saga">''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game Saga Edition Core Rulebook]]''</ref> It then appeared in the [[2009]] novel ''[[Fate of the Jedi: Outcast]]'', which was written by [[Aaron Allston]] as the opening installment in the ''[[Star Wars: Fate of the Jedi]]'' series.<ref name="Outcast">''[[Fate of the Jedi: Outcast]]''</ref>
